clips.text: Sydney, walking alongside the first-person viewer, gently teases in warm natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「你剛剛不是說只吃一攤？好啦，先逛一圈。前面有家手作攤。」She smiles, looks at actual stalls and keeps strolling. Begin with 2 seconds of the street and footsteps, then she glances back. Leah does not appear in this introductory shot.

Continue the same first-person stroll beside Sydney. Camera slows, looks past her toward the nearby tea stall: Leah, the SAME adult woman from the separate identity reference, is a few meters away looking down at her order receipt, occupied waiting for tea. A one-second hesitant pause. Sydney notices the gaze and moves slightly to the side to clear the viewer's path. She speaks softly in natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「有想認識她？先吐口氣。三、二、一。從她看得到的地方過去，我在這裡。」An encouraging half smile and a small nod toward Leah; a tiny forward camera movement suggests gathering courage. Keep both identities distinct, Sydney glasses/long hair/white dress; Leah short bob/beige blazer. No grabbing, no visible male hands, no handholding. Natural bustle continues.

First-person camera approaches gently from Leah's visible front-side and settles a respectful conversational distance away. An OFF CAMERA adult Taiwanese male voice says exactly:「嗨，妳這件米色外套搭得很好看，剛剛經過就注意到了。我想來跟妳打個招呼。」Leah looks up from her receipt with a slight surprised blink, not fear, and responds exactly:「喔，嗨。」She waits naturally, holds receipt, no coffee cup yet. No visible male body or hand.

Leah at the same tea stall still waiting for her drink, holding the order receipt. She slightly furrows her brows with real curiosity, asks conversationally in Taiwanese Mandarin:「你不是在賣東西吧？剛剛好多人在發傳單。」Glances briefly to the side where pedestrians pass then returns eye contact. NOT hostile, not a seductive pose. Natural lip sync and attentive breathing. No other dialogue.

Leah relaxes after hearing an honest clarification offscreen. She lets a small smile return and says naturally in Taiwanese Mandarin:「喔，原來是這樣。我叫 Leah。你是做什麼的？」Pronounce Leah as 莉亞. Hold her age 27 and original face. She puts the receipt at waist height and waits for a genuine answer. No other spoken line.

A flowing conversation at the tea stall, Leah holds receipt, waiting for tea. Exact alternating Taiwanese Mandarin dialogue, no narrator: Leah:「我做職能治療。下班有時去做陶杯。」Offscreen male:「我第一次拉坯，杯子歪得很有個性。」Leah playfully asks with a small amused smile:「那是杯子還是花盆？」Offscreen male, dry humor:「介於兩者，老師說很有個人風格。」Leah's smile becomes a brief genuine laugh; leave a short natural pause and eye contact. No theatrical posing or huge laugh.

Same warm conversation, Leah gives a little amused breath, then playfully tilts her head just slightly. Natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「至少還用得上。欸，你很常這樣跟女生打招呼嗎？」She is curious and teasing, not angry. A soft knowing smile, then quiet attentive wait. Keep receipt in hand, tea not collected yet.

Leah smiles at the viewer's just-finished answer and says naturally:「至少你有先說來意。」A middle-aged male tea vendor OFFSCREEN calls in Taiwanese Mandarin:「十七號，無糖烏龍！」Leah turns toward the counter, says to viewer:「我的茶好了，等我一下。」She takes ONE clear sealed takeaway cup of amber oolong tea, with a simple straw, then herself steps away from pickup counter to the side facing viewer. Viewer steps aside without touching. No instant cup teleport; show the pickup. Keep her beige blazer and identity.

Leah now stands to the side of the same tea stall holding ONE clear sealed takeaway cup of amber oolong. She checks a message on her phone briefly, returns gaze with a small curious smile and says Taiwanese Mandarin:「我朋友還要二十分鐘才來，還能逛一下。旁邊那家是在賣陶杯嗎？」Natural warm interest, not exaggerated seduction. No added dialogue.

Start beside the same tea stall, Leah holding her clear sealed amber oolong cup. She accepts a short nearby invitation in natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「好啊，去看一下。」She and first-person viewer walk TWO or THREE meters to the adjacent modest handcraft ceramic-cup stall, not a new district. One smooth motivated handheld move, maintain identity. Offscreen male:「這杯子比我的直很多。」Leah looks at ceramic cups then viewer:「拉坯要慢一點，急了就會歪。」Offscreen male:「那今天先欣賞就好。」Leah gently jokes:「先不要把它碰倒。」They share a brief small laugh. No touching people, no reaching hand, no kiss, no abrupt scene change.

At the side of tea stall, Leah holds ONE clear amber oolong cup. Briefly glances toward waiting friends in the distance then back to viewer. She says warmly but with real time constraint, natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「朋友在前面等我了。不過剛剛那個杯子的故事蠻好笑的。」She is preparing to go, not rushing dramatically and not disappointed. Preserve calm friendly age-27 face.

Leah at same tea stall with amber oolong cup, pleasantly agrees to viewer offering his contact information. Natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「好啊，我掃你。下次可以看看那個很有個性的杯子。我要先走了，掰掰。」She briefly raises her OWN phone toward a point below the camera to scan, no readable phone screen, no actual personal details/QR code. Returns phone to bag, friendly small farewell and turns naturally toward friends. No male hand, no handholding.

Leah at tea stall ends the interaction with composed polite clarity, not hostility or flirtation. Natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「謝謝，我先走了。祝你們逛得開心。」A small polite nod. She turns toward her own path and walks out of the conversational space. Camera remains respectfully still; never follows, blocks or touches her. Frame her from shoulders upward during speech; keep hands and props outside the frame so this farewell can follow either waiting or having collected tea. No extra dialogue.

Sydney and first-person viewer are together again at the same Taiwan night market edge. Sydney faces viewer slightly from the side, supportive and thoughtful, speaks in warm natural Taiwanese Mandarin:「剛剛哪一句，讓你最想急著解釋？先接住對方說的，再選你真的想說的。這個比背台詞重要。」Natural small smile, breathing and blinking, relaxed voice not formal lecture. No Leah in foreground. Maintain original Sydney face and eyeglasses.
